metadata.Name: MS MARCO
metadata.Description: MS MARCO is a large-scale dataset for information retrieval and question answering. It consists of real user queries from Bing search logs and corresponding web documents.
metadata.Paper Title: MS MARCO: A Human Generated Dataset for Training Conversational Search Systems
metadata.Abstract: We present MS MARCO, a new dataset for training conversational search systems. MS MARCO consists of over one million human-generated question-answer pairs, created from real queries issued to the Bing search engine. The dataset includes both human-written questions and relevant passages extracted from web pages. We also provide a set of human-generated relevance judgments for the passages, which can be used to train ranking models. We evaluate several state-of-the-art retrieval models on MS MARCO and show that our dataset leads to significant improvements in performance.
